title: The Trinity：面向多模态智能体的能力驱动递归自我改进框架
summary: 该论文提出The Trinity框架，通过Creator、Explorer、Evolver三个角色将世界生成与Harness演化耦合，把任务组织从表面类别重构为分层能力树，实现能力驱动的Real2Sim2Real与可复用能力模块演化。演化后的Harness在28个训练基准上平均提升34分，在18个未见基准上提升26分。
summary_en: The paper introduces The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution via Creator, Explorer, and Evolver roles. It reorganizes tasks from surface categories into a hierarchical capability tree, enabling Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real and reusable capability module evolution. Evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points on 28 training benchmarks and 26 points on 18 unseen benchmarks.
